CHAPTER 5 · ITEM 10 / 11

Supply elasticity and applications

Crop and restriction applications農作物與限制供給

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Analyze the revenue effects of a bumper crop versus a local crop failure, and supply restrictions in oil or illegal drugs; trace effects into related markets when needed.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

整體豐收可能因需求缺乏彈性而令總收入減少；局部農民面對其他地區替代品，失收可能降低自身收入。限制油或毒品供給可令價格及支出上升。

A broad supply increase can lower revenue when market demand is inelastic. A local producer faces more substitutes for its output, so a local crop loss can reduce its revenue. Restricting oil or drug supply can raise spending when demand is inelastic; linked complements may also be affected.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：Worldwide grain supply expands; price falls sharply and purchases rise slightly, reducing total farm revenue. 全球穀物豐收可能令農民總收入下降。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Supply of an inelastically demanded drug falls. User spending may do what? 毒品供給減、需求缺乏彈性，支出可能？
